notes.title: This Is the Comeback
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37274020/b5136843b3e017c7a00c1cdfa3695300768d1765.png

I’m back.

After years away from visual novel dev, I’ve launched a new Kickstarter to fund my return—starting with a brand-new game: Mystic Destinies: Rebirth – Gales of Hikaru.

The campaign ends soon, and I could really use your help in making it succeed: http://kck.st/44s6WOj

But this isn’t just about a new game. I need your help to come back and continue my projects, too.

It’s about coming back to everything—including TTEOTS.

Backers at the TTEOTS tier will get:

 Early access to the serialized TTEOTS novel
 Vote-based influence on what scenes/characters get expanded
 Exclusive short stories and dev updates
 Special thanks credit
 And access to the new Rebirth demo + live classes

This is a chance to help fund not just a new project, but my return to all the stories I’ve started and still want to finish.

Whether you’ve been here from the start or you just discovered this world—thank you for believing in me.

— Aja

I still want to finish what we started. And I hope you’ll still be part of it.
